Nothing compiles this: Node 24 strips the types and runs the .ts directly, which is why `fo` has no build step and no npm dependencies. `typeRoots` points into platform/typescript because the nix-built node_modules the devShell links there is the only one in the repo, and @types/node is the single thing `fo` needs from it. `erasableSyntaxOnly` keeps it that way - no enums, no namespaces, no parameter properties.
